calls.title: UPS Sync
calls.summary: UPS is evaluating Growth Book as a scalable replacement for Adobe Target to empower product managers and engineers to run tests independently, reducing dependence on the centralized 'Jedi Team'. Currently trialing Optimizely, UPS views Adobe Target as complex and limiting, which hinders experimentation volume. A key factor in moving forward is the integration with Adobe Analytics, which is crucial for maintaining data insights while replacing Target. Growth Book positions itself as user-friendly for both technical and non-technical users, contrasting with Optimizely's focus on marketers. The team's pricing strategy aims at larger enterprise clients, with emphasis on flexibility in deals ranging from $50K to $75K, while shifting focus toward clients with 500+ employees to maximize sales efficiency.
calls.keywords: UPS, Adobe Target, GrowthBook, experimentation, Optimizely, pricing negotiation
